notes.title: Use mouse to move view
notes.notes: It is now possible in the UI to press the two arrows next to the text rotate view, to rotate the view.

notes.title: Returns to a specific page of the first tutorial
notes.notes: Now when viewing the first tutorial you can choose the page to view, instead of moving forward one page at a time to the end of the tutorial.

notes.title: Clickable in game UI icons
notes.notes: Now the hints, exit and settings icons can be clicked with the mouse.

notes.title: Language support
notes.notes: Added language support for Romanian, Swedish, Finnish, Polish and Hungarian.

notes.title: Language support
notes.notes: Added language support for Thai, Norwegian and Simplified Chinese.

notes.title: Improved the initial tutorial
notes.notes: Now when you start the game for the first time, instead of having just one screen, there are five screens in succession that better explain how the pieces fit together.

notes.title: Move puzzle tiles with mouse
notes.notes: You can now use the mouse to move the puzzle pieces.

notes.title: Added key rebinding
notes.notes: Controls fixed and added key rebinding.

notes.title: Avoid getting stuck at first puzzle
notes.notes:
If you fail to complete the first level (the one unlocked from the level selection menu), now the second time you fail to solve the puzzle a popup window will appear asking if you want to repeat the tutorial level.
This is to avoid getting stuck at the first puzzle of the game.
